title: Old Friends
blurb: For groups who go way back: old stories, old grudges and who has changed the least.

questions.text: Who at this table has changed the least since we first met?
Who would be most likely to still have their old school uniform?
Who is most likely to remember every embarrassing story about everyone here?
Who would be most likely to show up to a reunion with a whole new personality?
Who at this table would you call first if you needed help at three in the morning?
Who would bring up an argument from ten years ago?
Who among us is most likely to have photos from every party we've ever been to?
Who would be most likely to organise the next catch-up?
Who do you reckon is most likely to cancel the next catch-up at the last minute?
Who's the one most likely to move overseas and reply to messages once a month?
Who would be most likely to still be in the group chat at ninety?
Who is most likely to tell a story everyone here has heard ten times?
Who would be most likely to get the whole group kicked out of a restaurant?
Who at this table would give the best wedding speech?
Who would still owe someone here money from years ago?
Who among us is most likely to have kept a secret about this group for years?
Who would be most likely to remember everyone's birthday without a reminder?
Who do you reckon is most likely to have buried a time capsule somewhere?
Who's the one most likely to drag the group on a trip nobody else wanted?
Who would be most likely to cry while looking through old photos?
Who at this table would win a trivia round on the history of this group?
Who is most likely to still be friends with their primary school pen pal?
Who would be most likely to start a nostalgic singalong at the end of the night?
Who would mute the group chat and miss every plan?

Who do you reckon is most likely to suggest we all get matching tattoos?
Who at this table would be best at planning a surprise party?
Who's the one most likely to accidentally ruin a surprise party?
Who would be most likely to write a book about this friendship group?

Who has the worst haircut in our oldest group photo?
Who would be most likely to still own a CD they borrowed from someone here?
Who would be first to cry at a 21st birthday slideshow?
Who would turn up to a reunion in the exact same outfit as school?
Who among us is most likely to bring up a nickname we all agreed to retire?
Who has told the most lies to a teacher on behalf of this group?
Who would be most likely to remember the name of our first ever teacher?
Who do you reckon is most likely to say "remember when" three times before the entrée?
Who's the one most likely to get the group back together for a trip after ten years?
Who would be most likely to still have a school photo of the whole group in their wallet?
Who had the most embarrassing first car?
Who is most likely to confess something from the old days we've never heard?

Who would ring everyone on their birthday instead of texting?

Who among us is most likely to become a grandparent first?
Who is the one we would all trust to look after our kids?
Who is most likely to slip straight back into their high school voice when we all catch up?
Who would be most likely to turn up to our 50th birthday with a surprise guest from the past?
Who do you reckon is most likely to retire first and rub it in?
Who's the one most likely to have kissed someone in this group back in the day?
Who at this table has the most secrets the rest of us don't know about?
Who would be most likely to have dated someone that a friend here also dated?
Who is most likely to still be texting an ex this group warned them about?
